w: The Mahelav village Council passed a resolution to name the lane where Shastriji Maharaj lived as 'Yagnapurush Pol'. Swamishri performed pujan of the name plate.
At 10.00 a.m. Swamishri arrived in Virol and performed pujan and arti of murtis at the Swaminarayan Mandir. Thereafter a small assembly was held and Swamishri blessed the devotees.
At 11.00 a.m. Swamishri arrived in Jesarva and performed the murti-pratishtha at the Swaminarayan Mandir.
Swamishri returned to Mahelav at about 12 noon.
At 7.20 p.m. Swamishri arrived in Rojid and held a public satsang assembly. Thereafter, Swamishri departed for Sarangpur.

UK Satsang Suvarna Jayanti Sunday 5 September 2004 saw the celebrations of the 50th Anniversary of BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha in the UK. A spectacular show was put on by kishores and yuvaks in the presence of Swamishri. The kishores and yuvaks had spent some nine months researching the history of how satsang was established in the UK.

The show contained spectacular laser, musical fountains and lighting effects, combined with specially choreographed colourful dances, dramas and sketches that traced the history of BAPS UK not just back to Yogiji Maharaj but back to the time of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and how He had looked to the West when he climbed a pipal tree when young. The stunning event was enjoyed by all and Swamishri in his blessings spoke of the efforts of the devotees in not only constructing a beautiful Mandir but also in imbibing satsang in their lives. Kishores had also prepared a stunning limited edition photographic memories book - Sahaj Anand - of 340 pages documenting the history of BAPS UK. The book was available with a DVD of rare footage of Yogiji Maharaj from 1970 and Pramukh Swami Maharaj over the past 34 years.

w: In the evening the Chief Minister of Haryana Shri Bhupendrasinh Hooda came for Swamishri’s darshan with some of his cabinet ministers. He was appreciative of Swaminarayan Akshardham and requested Swamishri to build one in Kurukshetra. Thereafter the Finance Minister of India, Shri Chidambaram, came to Swamishri after seeing Akshardham. He, too, expressed his appreciation for the cultural complex.

A devotee named Rajubhai, telling of an incident from his life, said, "I have a big business in mango pulp in Jambusar. My shop is called 'Yogi Rasbhandar'. Until 1983 I had no satsang. I was a worshipper of the Mother Goddess, but I never went to her temple. My life was full of addictions and vices. During that time a friend of mine once insisted, 'Come with us to Bochasan for Guru Purnima.' Because of my friend's insistence I went to Bochasan. In fact I had always disliked the Swaminarayan sadhus. I was not even ready to set foot in a Swaminarayan mandir. So I just stayed sitting in the special bus, but because my friend insisted, I set foot in the mandir for the first time. I did not even go for darshan of God. I sat near the book stall.

Meanwhile Swamishri was giving blessings in the Guru Purnima assembly. My friend said, 'Until now you have seen Pramukh Swami Maharaj only in photos. Now that you have come this far, at least see him in person from a distance once!' Because of my friend's insistence I went to have darshan from a distance. I had no respect in it, but when I had Swamishri's darshan, a miracle happened. My thoughts began to change, and a wish began to arise in my mind: 'I want to see this sadhu up close, I want to meet him.' In those days, right after the festival, Swamishri would give everyone the chance to touch his feet personally and offer worship. So I was drawn there on my own. My friend introduced me. Swamishri said only this to me: 'Do not keep any addictions.' And who knows how, my cravings simply stopped. To this day I have not had any craving for addictions."
Shrijikirtan Swami, who had gone to hold parayans (series of discourses) during the Shravan travels, told Pramukh Swami Maharaj about some of the devotees' experiences. He said:

"We had gone to Anumala Kakrapar. There is a Government of India atomic power station here. There is a large township where the engineers and other staff working there live. In this township many families are our satsangis. This time, while doing padharamanis in the township, we met Rameshkumar, an engineer from South India. He has been living here for the last twelve years. He has great goodwill towards Swamishri and the organisation. Speaking of Swamishri's glory, he said, 'You sadhus have to say something or other to spread satsang, but Guruji (Pramukh Swami Maharaj) says a great deal through his conduct. Once I went to Sankari. I had his darshan in the assembly. At that time Guruji was turning his mala. That image of his settled in my heart, and I was inspired that the one thing worth doing in life is worshipping God.'"

ds.t: Thinking of the devotees while lying in bed
w: Today, after the mangala arti, when Mahant Swami Maharaj came to his residence, he said of his own accord, "Last night, lying in bed, I thought that all the devotees should become pure."

Shriji Maharaj has said, "I do not want to leave even a sesame seed's worth of shortcoming in those who are called mine..." This morning everyone saw this same nature in Swamishri. Having found Swamishri, who delights in thoughts of the devotees not only while awake but even while lying in bed, everyone felt blessed.

Today Mahant Swami Maharaj came for darshan in the abhishek mandap. Here, after the arti, a chair was placed for him to sit beside the pedestal on which Maharaj's murti is seated, but Swamishri at once had it moved to the step below. Only then did he sit on it. How subtle his attention to the respect due to Thakorji!

Mahant Swami Maharaj came to a meeting room in the World Wildlife Fund (WWF) building to meet former American President Shri Barack Obama. Obama pulled out the chair at the middle of the table. Swamishri and everyone thought he was arranging the chair for himself, so Swamishri went to sit on another chair. But Obama, with great respect, said to Swamishri, "Please sit here," seated him as the "head of the table," and himself sat on the chair to Swamishri's right.
Even Mr Obama became convinced at the very first meeting that the true person worthy of being "Head of the table" can only be a divine great soul like Swamishri.
(He alone) could be.
